question: Dead time is the time required by an instrument to _____ to respond to change in _____ quantity.
solution:
The correct answer is __begin; input__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dead time__ refers to the delay period between a change in input quantity and the start of the instrument's response.
 
• It is an important performance parameter of measuring instruments.
 
• Shorter dead time indicates faster responsiveness and better efficiency of the instrument.
 
• Instruments with longer dead time are less suitable for dynamic measurements.
 
• Dead time can be reduced with advanced sensors and processing techniques.
 
• Understanding dead time is crucial for accurate calibration and system design.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Response Time:**
 
 
• It is the total time taken by an instrument to respond to a change in input.
 
• Response time includes both dead time and the time required to reach a steady-state.
 
 
 
• **Settling Time:**
 
 
• It is the time taken by an instrument to stabilize within a certain percentage of the final value after a change in input.
 
• Instruments with shorter settling times are ideal for dynamic applications.
 
 
 
• **Accuracy:**
 
 
• Accuracy refers to the closeness of the measurement to the true value.
 
• Precise calibration enhances measurement accuracy.
